no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not the subject for an advisory committee (AC). Two other oral anti-coagulants (dabigatran and rivaroxaban) have been approved for marketing for stroke prevention in patients with AF and so the issues presented by this NDA did not seem particularly novel or controversial at the time of filing. Trial conduct issues were identified late in the review cycle (the application was a priority review). The possibility of an advisory committee was then re-considered but it was concluded that the issues raised could not be usefully addressed by an AC with the information currently available.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the apixaban (Eliquis) NDA202155 approval; the medical review explicitly states the application was not the subject of an AC because the issues were not novel given prior approvals of dabigatran and rivaroxaban, and a later reconsideration prompted by trial-conduct concerns concluded an AC could not usefully address those issues with available information. A dissenting reviewer repeatedly proposed convening an AC to discuss a possible bleeding/cancer association, but no such meeting was held. Because no AdComm took place, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
